test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which Clause of Article 20 incorporates the doctrine of double jeopardy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Clause 2** of Article 20 incorporates the doctrine of double jeopardy.
 
• Double jeopardy means that no person shall be prosecuted and punished for the same offense more than once.
 
• Article 20 of the Indian Constitution provides protection in respect of conviction for offenses.
